title: ‘Thank God That’s Over’: Andrew Garfield on Why He Hated Playing Sam Altman in New Movie
content:
Andrew Garfield was passed over for the role of Mark Zuckerberg in The Social Network, but The Amazing Spider-Man alum now finds himself stepping into the shoes of another tech giant. In Italian director Luca Guadagnino’s upcoming drama Artificial, Garfield stars as OpenAI CEO Sam Altman in a story detailing Altman’s sudden firing and rehiring […]
